■ Stage Direction
Age: 50s
Personality: Gentle, intellectual

"As long as objects or lives are here, they can get back on their feet any number of times.
—Just like this partner of yours."

...................
I am truly honored to hear you say that.
"And there is one more essential skill alongside maintenance."

"Yes, that's right. ...What do you say, Ikuno-kun?
Would you like to learn how to fight against the anxiety you carry?"

This serves strictly as a tool for management, I see.
I should follow suit and take care as well.

Seeing my partner, which used to ride so powerfully, stop dead in an instant...
I just stood frozen... and at that moment, a thought suddenly struck me.
However——I must respectfully decline.

That was precisely why I wondered. How did she acquire such diligence
and extraordinary self-management skills—
...Meeting that person was purely coincidental.
Yes. How may I help you?

That is the ultimate 'goal' I have derived—
to prove both my racing capabilities and my mentor's teachings.

The one who spoke to me was Sensei...—
My mentor.

Ikuno Dictus's desire to learn and her comprehension
are truly remarkable...—

"Leave it to me. Maintenance like this happens to be a hobby of mine.
It looks pretty banged up, but replace a few parts and—"

A grandiose goal that seemed contradictory to her impeccably pragmatic way of being.
Yet the light in Ikuno Dictus's eyes as she spoke... was firm and resolute.

I shared various knowledge, such as the details of self-check sheets,
self-massage techniques, and dietary recipes tailored to her—

That by utilizing the management and maintenance Sensei taught me,
I could surely... go as far as my legs would take me.

...! It's delicious...!
The fruitiness is refreshing, and the mouthfeel is smooth—
"Maintenance..."

If it is her, she will surely achieve that goal.
And that... aligns with the vow I carry within myself as well.
"Namely, 'management.'"

'Just how far can I run?'
...And I felt the desire to prove it.

"—With that maintenance and management,
can we... stay healthy forever?"

Furthermore, this management and maintenance could be applied
not only to servicing my partner, but to my own running as well—

...Come to think of it, there is something I would like to ask
regarding this lower limb self-check item—

...The reason I am holding this 'study session' with Ikuno Dictus now
traces back to our interaction the other day—

No. Someone taught me the fundamentals.
Someone who took care of me before I entered the academy... a person I could call my mentor.

...Sensei ran a chiropractic clinic primarily for racing Umamusume,
and also serviced sports equipment and bicycles as a hobby.

——...I see. Rather than relying on a single check sheet,
you create multiple patterns to adapt to all kinds of situations.
"Wah...! Amazing! It's really fixed...!"
If you do not mind, would you be willing to share your knowledge with me?

"—You said your name was Ikuno-kun, right? Even though your bike is on track to be fixed,
you look quite downcast. Does something still hurt?"

From your words and actions, I sensed a resolute determination
to 'keep Umamusume running healthily for a long time.'

The time spent cutting through the wind with my partner was pure bliss...
I would often forget the passage of time and ride far away.

Sensei listened in silence while repairing my partner.
...To the vague, inexplicable fear that my young self could not put into words—
"—Are you alright?"

That is why—
as a Trainer, I want to help Ikuno Dictus...!

"This is 'maintenance.'
The skill that allows us to get back up again whenever we encounter hardship."

Aside from being delicious, it is wonderful that the ingredients are so commonplace.
I appreciate that this can be implemented right away.
That is————

At the same time, I also wished to learn from your knowledge,
which led me to make this proposal. ...What do you say?

...I told them.
About the chilling dread I felt the moment my partner broke down.

—And so, having learned management and maintenance from Sensei,
I was able to dispel the anxieties that had once haunted me.

—When you recommended an examination the other day, I was secretly
impressed by your meticulous perspective on Umamusume.

"—It's true that things break. We get injured too.
However... that doesn't mean it's the end right then and there."

—Long ago, I had a sports bike I considered my 'partner.'
...A precious machine given to me by my parents.
"Um... Can you really fix it...?"

...However, one day, I had a fall,
and broke my precious partner—

—As I came to realize the joy of running and feeling the wind against me,
a feeling began to surge within my heart.

"...Ikuno-kun. Please remember this well. When something is damaged and broken,
repairing it like this will always allow it to move once again."

In that case... taking you up on your kind offer,
there is something I would like to ask—

Once objects... once living beings... break like this...
they can never run again...—

Unable to suppress the cold dread welling up inside me,
all I could do was stare at my broken partner—

—After that, I gladly accepted Ikuno Dictus's proposal,
and we decided to hold study sessions to share our knowledge.

"The art of managing oneself and one's surroundings, handling difficulties in advance,
remaining unbroken, unhurt, and steadily marching toward one's dreams and goals—"
—To run longer than anyone else, and to rack up more victories than anyone else.

—Currently, we had borrowed a corner of the cafeteria,
and I was teaching her how to make smoothies.
